correctness.evidence: Independent from-definition octal mex DP through n=12000 reproduced new samples, both cold lists, extrema, and an exhaustive q<=8000,p<=2000 scan with the stated latest first-failure witnesses.

originality.evidence: OEIS/Flammenkamp checks show a public 10,000-value frontier for these sequences and no matching 12,000 extension or period-exclusion box in the checked sources; priority is asserted only relative to that search.

value.evidence: The work advances exact data for named unresolved five-digit octal games, supplies per-candidate nonclosure witnesses in a large finite box, and records new cold/extremal information relevant to eventual-periodicity classification.
